name: Medical, dental and community-clinic night janitorial (OSHA BBP-compliant), Chicago West/Southwest side and near-west suburbs
summary: Owner-operated janitorial contractor for 2,000-15,000 sq ft outpatient sites (FQHC sites, dental/specialty practices, PT clinics, small ASCs). Customer unit = one clinic site under a monthly fixed-fee contract. Cleaning crews are direct labour inside gross margin; supervisors, office and sales are staff.
evidence_notes: Wages: Chicago minimum wage $17.05/hr from 1 Jul 2026 [A, DA-S013]; Chicago MSA janitor median $18.49/hr, 25th pct $17.48 [C, DA-S012]; Illinois prevailing janitorial wage (state contracts, Cook) $22.40/hr + $949.87/mo health + $56/wk pension [A, DA-S026] - the union-scale benchmark private non-union firms undercut.

Prices: public health-centre bid spread $1,950-29,825/mo [A, C1-S023]; VA Kankakee County clinic janitorial $579,737 over ~5 yrs (~$116k/yr) and Peoria CBOC $714,184 over 4 yrs [A, DA-S023]; Winnebago County (incl. 2 health dept sites) $27,899/mo for 11 locations, 60-day no-cause termination [A, DA-S025]. Private clinic price per sq ft MISSING; ARPC below is E derived from labour hours.
Structure: IL janitorial payroll = 40.6% of receipts [C, C1-S021]; ABM operating margin 3.6% at scale [A, WS08-S037].

Insurance: Illinois cleaners via broker avg GL $83/mo, WC $134/mo (small firms); janitorial bond ~$10/mo; commercial auto $234/mo [C, DA-S009]. Public clients require $1-2M GL and up to $5M umbrella [A, DA-S025].
OSHA 1910.1030: exposure control plan, Hep B vaccination offered free within 10 working days, annual paid training [A, C1-S024]. Vaccine cost MISSING (CDC price list blocked) - E.
Funnel, churn and ARPC are E; validation plan tests them.

drivers.sales_start_delay_months__source: LLC, insurance/bond, BBP written program; no IL janitorial licence identified [C1 memo; ilga.gov unavailable].
drivers.sales_cycle_months__source: Walkthrough + proposal + incumbent notice; public contracts carry 30-60 day termination notice [A, DA-S025]; private cycle E.
drivers.founder_leads_per_month__source: Qualified practice-manager/landlord conversations; ~245 active FQHC sites in Cook County [A, DA-S022] plus 12,500+ IL physician/dental offices [C, C1-S022]. Volume E.
drivers.proposal_to_win_pct__source: Eight bidders on one public health-centre bid [A, C1-S023] implies ~12% if random; private proposals assumed slightly better. L.E.K.: ~37% of FMs switched a provider in past year [C, DA-S019].
drivers.referral_new_per_100_active__source: Multi-site FQHC/dental groups and medical-office landlords add sites once trust exists (E).
drivers.monthly_churn_pct__source: No janitorial churn statistic found (MISSING). 60-day no-cause termination is standard [A, DA-S025]; incumbents can hold 7+ yrs (Winnebago since 2017) [A, DA-S025]; ~37% switch rate across FM services [C, DA-S019]. Base 21%/yr E.
drivers.arpc_monthly__source: Blended site: ~4,000 sq ft, 5 nights/wk, ~1.8 labour-h/night (E production rate) priced at ~$0.30-0.45/sq ft/mo (E); small dental 3x/wk ~$600-900; FQHC sites larger. Anchors: public spread $1,950-29,825/mo [A, C1-S023]; VA clinic ~$9.7k/mo (federal SCA wages) [A, DA-S023].
drivers.onetime_revenue_per_new_customer__source: Initial deep clean / floor strip-and-wax at start (E).
drivers.arpc_annual_growth_pct__source: Chicago minimum wage is indexed annually (rose $16.60 -> $17.05 in 2026, +2.7%) [A, DA-S013]; escalators common [C, DA-S019]. Pass-through assumed.
drivers.gross_margin_pct__source: Direct crew labour + supplies. Transaction 1: 39 h x $18.50 wage x ~1.22 load (FICA, UI, WC, Chicago paid leave/sick) + ~5% supplies = $956 on $1,500 => 36%. Wage floor A [DA-S013], median C [DA-S012]. IL payroll/receipts 40.6% [C, C1-S021] suggests mature firms bill more per labour hour; entrant set at 36%.
drivers.variable_opex_pct_revenue__source: Inter-site travel reimbursement, processing, bad debt (E).
drivers.cac_per_new_customer__source: Proposal materials, walkthrough travel, small paid listings (E).
drivers.dso_days__source: Net-30 invoicing; FQHC/public prompt-payment acts allow longer (Winnebago: Local Government Prompt Payment Act) [A, DA-S025]; realized days E.
drivers.dpo_days__source: COGS is ~88% labour paid biweekly (~7 days) + supplies on net-30 from Imperial Dade/Grainger (terms assumed) -> ~10 days blended.
drivers.ev_multiple__source: Small janitorial firms trade at low multiples (no source accessible; BizBuySell blocked) - 2.5x assumed.
